## AI engineering best practices
- **How to Build Production-Ready LLM Evaluation Pipelines for AI Agents in ...** — https://explore.n1n.ai/blog/production-ready-llm-eval-pipelines-2026-2026-07-31
  A deep dive into the four-layer evaluation framework for AI agents, featuring code implementations for tool-calling tests, LLM-as-a-Judge rubrics, and CI/CD integration using high-performance LLM APIs.

  LLMOps guide — move an LLM feature from proof of concept to a reliable, cost-controlled production AI pipeline with retrieval, evaluation, and monitoring.
- **Context Engineering Best Practices Every Developer Should Follow** — https://www.rocket.new/blog/context-engineering-best-practices-developers-should-follow
  Context engineering is the discipline of designing dynamic systems that control what information an LLM receives, when it arrives, and how it is formatted, so AI agents succeed before they generate a single token. Most production AI failures trace back to context architecture, not model capability.

  OpenAI API production architecture blueprint for senior engineers: async request handling, caching, rate limiting, and failure isolation for high-traffic systems.

  Blueprint for a production LLM inference stack instrumented with Prometheus: vLLM metrics, alert design, and autoscaling triggers for high-traffic architecture teams.
- **LLM A/B Testing: A Production Statistics Framework [2026]** — https://atlan.com/know/ab-testing-llm-applications/
  Learn how to A/B test LLM applications in production: isolate variables, run power analysis, choose a randomization unit, and build a CI/CD regression gate.

  The Four Layers of LLM Engineering A friendly, visual field guide to prompt engineering, context engineering, harness engineering, and loop engineering — for technical and non-technical readers alike.
- **LLM Monitoring vs Observability: Top Tools for 2026 - Confident AI** — https://www.confident-ai.com/knowledge-base/compare/llm-monitoring-vs-observability-top-tools-2026
